metadata.title: Door Blue Space · Creative apartment in Tbilisi
metadata.description: A creatively designed apartment in Tbilisi for events, coworking and community. See current events on Telegram and find the blue door.

hero.title: Come through the blue door.
hero.lead: Door Blue Space is a creatively designed apartment in Tbilisi for films, music, workshops and community gatherings.
hero.note: Events are announced on Telegram. When one is on, you can simply come—no advance registration.

events.title: What’s happening lives on Telegram.
events.description: Film nights, music, workshops and gatherings are announced there with current dates and details.
events.invitation: See something you like? Come by—no advance registration is needed.

uses.title: The apartment changes with the day.
uses.description: Events bring people together. On quieter weekdays, the same rooms can become a place to work—or a place for your own gathering.

coworking.title: Cowork here
coworking.description: Write before you come. The apartment may be rented on the day, so coworking availability needs to be confirmed.

rental.title: Rent the space
rental.description: If you would like to use Door Blue Space for your own gathering, write in advance to ask about availability.

journey.title: The last turn is blue.
waypoints: Use the Valeo entrance near the barrier.
Go up to the fourth floor.
journey.arrival: Fourth floor. Turn right. You’re there.
journey.helpAction: Need help finding us? Message on Telegram

closing.title: We’ll meet you on the other side.
closing.description: Come to announced events without registering in advance. Arrange coworking or rental before you arrive.

metadata.title: Support Door Blue Space · Donations
metadata.description: Support Door Blue Space with the upkeep of the apartment, rent and community events. Find Bank of Georgia transfer details.

hero.title: Support Door Blue Space.
hero.description: Use the bank details below to make a transfer in Georgian lari.

transfer.title: Make a bank transfer.
transfer.instructions: The account is in Georgian lari. Copy the details below, then complete the transfer in your banking app.
transfer.copyError: Couldn’t copy automatically. Select the value and copy it manually.
transfer.sameBankFee: Transfers from Bank of Georgia have no fee.
transfer.otherBankFee: Transfers from other banks have a 1 GEL fee.
transfer.unavailableDescription: Message us on Telegram and we’ll send you the current donation details.
transfer.helpAction: Message Door Blue Space on Telegram

support.title: What your support helps us do.
support.description: Every contribution supports the practical work of keeping a creative, shared place running in Tbilisi.

items.title: Care for the apartment
items.copy: Support helps with the everyday upkeep of the rooms we share.

items.title: Pay the rent
items.copy: It helps keep Door Blue Space available as a place for the community.

items.title: Organise events
items.copy: It helps us bring films, music, workshops and gatherings into the space.
